parameters.help_en: The name of the application. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称，可自定义字符串，长度不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application. Valid values:

SQL
STREAMING
BATCH (default)
parameters.help_zh:
应用类型，取值说明：
SQL：SQL应用。
STREAMING：流应用。
BATCH（默认值）：离线应用
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.example: conf spark.driver.resourceSpec=small; conf spark.executor.instances=1; conf spark.executor.resourceSpec=small; conf spark.app.name=TestApp;
parameters.help_en:
The data of the application template.

For information about the application template configuration, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452402.html
parameters.help_zh:
应用模板数据。
应用模板配置，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452402.html

parameters.help_en: The type of the client. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端类型。可自定义字符串，长度不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: agent_source

parameters.help_en: The version of the client. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序使用的版本。可自定义字符串，长度不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the job resource group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612410.html operation to query the name of a resource group within a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
Job型资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612410.html接口查看集群的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application template.

parameters.help_zh:
应用模板ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456205.html接口可以查询应用模板ID
parameters.name: template_file_id

Message.description_en: The alert message returned for the operation, such as task execution failure or insufficient resources. If no alert occurs, null is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回告警信息，如任务执行失败或资源不足等，无告警时则返回为空

State.description_en:
The execution state of the application. Valid values:

SUBMITTED
STARTING
RUNNING
FAILING
FAILED
KILLING
KILLED
SUCCEEDING
COMPLETED
FATAL
UNKNOWN
State.description_zh:
应用执行状态，取值说明：
SUBMITTED：已提交。
STARTING：开始启动。
RUNNING：执行中。
FAILING：任务失败，清理环境中。
FAILED：失败。
KILLING：中止任务，清理环境中。
KILLED：中止任务。
SUCCEEDING：任务执行结束，清理环境中。
COMPLETED：任务执行结束。
FATAL：意外失败。
UNKNOWN：未知错误
